Maya (CS): Morning all 061 quick kickoff for NimbusEdge onboarding. We need stakeholders, concrete success criteria, timeline, and any early renewal risks. Can each owner call out blockers?
Jake (Solutions Eng): I can own infra work. Need: S3 bucket ARN, a service account with read access, and the customer's egress rules for our CIDR. Also: what's expected peak QPS (approx)?
Sam (Customer Tech Lead): Hi Maya/Jake  we're planning ~120 QPS peak, avg payload 1.2KB. I'll provision an S3 bucket and a read-only service principal. Firewall is managed by our infra team (cc: infra@acme.example).
Sophie (PM): Success criteria draft: 1) Core API flows pass smoke tests (end-to-end) with <200ms median on our test corpus; 2) Data ingestion completed and validated with schema pass rate >95%; 3) Support handover complete with runbook and playbooks, and top-3 failure modes documented. Renewal risk: they noted a contract clause about latency penalties in month 1.
Raj (Eng Lead): Technical risks: cert pinning on their side, larger-than-expected cold-start for large context. We'll prepare a canary with warmed KV caches and a degraded-mode model fallback. Proposed timeline: 
```
Day 0-2: Access, creds, and discovery (S3 sample files)
Day 3-9: Environment setup + initial ingest + network validation
Day 10-16: Integration, canary deploy, smoke tests
Day 17-23: Perf tuning, mitigation of spikes, final runbook draft
Day 24-30: Enablement sessions, go/no-go, and handover
```
Maya (CS): I'll put that into the intake doc and invite the customer to the infra walkthrough. Also need to schedule enablement for their L1 and L2 during week 4. Proposed slots: Wed 2026-04-08 10:00 PT and Fri 2026-04-10 09:00 PT.
Jake (Solutions Eng): Wed works for infra deep-dive. For the install window, prefer Tue overnight window to minimize impact.
Sam (Customer Tech Lead): Overnight Tue OK. I'll share firewall contact and cert team lead.
Sophie (PM): I'll assemble a 50-sample prompt corpus and a perf checklist. Also will prepare an eval sheet so we can mark pass/fail per metric.
OnboardBot: Reminder: attach intake doc link and add calendar invites within 24h.
Maya (CS): Draft message I'll send to Sam: 
```
Hi Sam  quick asks to unblock setup:
- S3 bucket ARN + sample files (s3://...)
- Service account credentials with read-only access
- Firewall contact + CIDR allowlist (we'll use 10.2.0.0/16 egress)
- Expected QPS & peak payload size
- Point of contact for cert/PKI
Thanks, Maya (Redwood CS)
```
Jake (Solutions Eng): Action items from our side: infra checklist, canary config template, and list of perf knobs (batching settings, kv-cache warmup, quantization profile suggestion).
Raj (Eng Lead): I'll prepare fallback model variant config and a short runbook for degraded-mode behavior.
Maya (CS): Recap actions:
- Maya: send comms + book invites + update intake doc
- Jake: infra checklist + request S3 samples + propose install window
- Raj: canary config + degraded-mode runbook
- Sophie: eval sheet + 50-sample corpus
- Sam: share firewall & cert contacts, create service account
Maya (CS): Anything else? If not I'll send the kickoff note to Sam and create the invites. :thumbsup:
Sam (Customer Tech Lead): That covers it. I'll aim to have S3 + contacts by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (CS): Great, thanks everyone. I'll ping when invites are set.
